intro.name: Alexander Saballos
intro.headline: Electrical Engineer (US EI/EiT) | Software Engineer | HU Walton Alumni

about.introduction: This space showcases systems and projects I've built at the intersection of hardware, software, and infrastructure. I graduated Cum Laude as a Walton Scholar from Harding University (AR, US) with an ABET-accredited B.S. in Electrical Engineering, a minor in Mathematics, and passed the NCEES FE Exam prior to graduation, which enabled me to receive a US EI/EiT license. My work spans embedded systems, power and PCB design, automation, and software development, with a strong emphasis on documentation, long-term maintainability, and practical solutions designed to perform reliably beyond the lab environment.
